items.text: Future Career School offers career counselling for parents who are ready to book but still weighing the questions that matter most from your side of the table - is this credible, will your child actually open up, and how do you know it is working.

The session is built around your child\'s real strengths, so the direction they move toward can support achieving earlier financial freedom through the right skills, instead of another year lost to indecision.
Guidance is delivered fully online across India, so your child can join from home, school, or wherever is convenient, without your family depending on a local counsellor being available or good.
